text:
Maya Patel: thinking about a Console UX tweak — a "Preview logs" button on route pages that shows a sampled req/res to help debugging without flipping inspect mode. worried about PII leakage though
Aj Rivera: +1 for visibility. we need strict rules: preview must show sampled payload only, and redaction confidence must be visible. propose confidence buckets: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW. HIGH = show token-level pseudonymized ids, MEDIUM = partial mask, LOW = fully redact sensitive spans. :mag:
Sam Wu: how would that interact with sampler/quota? previews could be an easy DOS on quota if every engineer clicks. we need a per-tenant preview budget and a telemetry counter. maybe preview consumes a very small sampled token budget that is separate from audit logs
Tess O'Neil: agree w/Sam. also the preview should surface why something was redacted (heuristic id or model span, e.g., "regex:ssn", "ner:PERSON"). we can add a hover with the redaction signal and confidence score. tiny UX detail but important for trust
Aj Rivera: implementation idea: sampler hint field in the request metadata that signals intended preview redaction level. sampler can then use quota-aware fallback. example metadata: 
```
{"sampler_hint":"preview_low_confidence","preview_ttl":"10s","actor":"console"}
```
Maya Patel: example log snippet for preview (how it would look):
```
Request: {"user_input":"my ssn is 123-45-6789 and email is maya@example.com"}
PreviewResponse: {"response":"sorry, can\'t help with that"}
AuditView:
  user_input: "my ssn is [REDACTED:PII:LOW_CONF] and email is [PSEUD:email:HIGH_CONF]"
  redaction_reasons: ["regex:ssn","ner:EMAIL"]
```
Jordan (eng-sre): breakglass: oncall needs a path to see unredacted preview for incident investigation but it must be logged and tracked. prefer a time-limited, audited token flow rather than permanent console perms. also we need an ops metric so we know how often unredact is used
Sam Wu: quota interactions again — if preview hits the inference plane we need to ensure it routes to cheaper variants or cached prefixes. suggest preview requests use a special routing policy: route.priority=background_preview, prefer cached/quantized variant
Aj Rivera: implementation sketch for server API change: add optional header `X-Preview-Mode: <level>` and `X-Preview-Request-Id`. sampler checks header, consults per-tenant preview_budget, then either returns sampled masked payload or 403 if budget exceeded. fallback: return "preview unavailable due to budget" UI state
Tess O'Neil: UX note: show a small shield icon and tooltip when content is partially redacted. allow users to request an audit view which opens a support ticket flow (not automatic unredact). keep the "peek" ephemeral and non-cacheable
Maya Patel: open question: should previews ever include embeddings/derivative telemetry? that could leak prompt info. my vote: never include embeddings or raw prompts in preview, only high-level sanitized text and redaction metadata
Jordan (eng-sre): +1 on no embeddings. also we should emit a telemetry event with fields: preview_level, tenant_id, route, preview_outcome (shown|blocked|audited). keep it minimal to avoid PII in telemetry
Aj Rivera: quick config proto for sampler rules (pseudo):
```
sampler_rules:
  - name: preview_quota_check
    header: X-Preview-Mode
    budget_key: tenant.preview_budget
    fallback: mask_and_sample
    routing_hint: prefer_cached_variant
```
Maya Patel: can someone prototype a tiny canary? Aj, Jordan, want to pair for a 2-week spike: server header + sampler budget + console button (no unredact). I can do the UI frame if you want
Aj Rivera: I can mock the sampler change and add the header handling. will also add tests that simulate quota exhaustion
Jordan (eng-sre): I\'ll add the audit event and breakglass token flow doc in the runbook (short note)
AuditBot: created ticket #INF-8742 for "console preview + preview_budget" and linked runbook PR-221
Tess O'Neil: one more UX thought — show a subtle "confidence" pill (green/amber/red) next to each redacted span so engineers understand what to do next
Maya Patel: ok action items: Aj spike + mock, Jordan runbook + telemetry, Maya UI scaffold, Tess small UX copy for confidence pills. sync Thu 10am to review canary results. thanks! :raised_hands:
